data.name: Shadow Puppets
data.description: The shadow puppeteer can use bardic performance to create one quasi-real shadowy creature resembling a monster from the summon monster %2 list. These shadowy creatures otherwise work like shadow conjuration, and targets interacting with them get a Will saving throw (DC %1) to treat them as only 20%% real.|10+BardLVL/2+CHA|1+(BardLVL-1)/3
